basis: Sex-hormone-driven precocious puberty is an endocrine disorder.
Congenital non-neoplastic skin lesion.
Benign breast adenoma; breast has no axis.
Immunodeficiency; granulomatous skin ulcers ~50%. Bronchiectasis follows secondary infections. [Review](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16087697/)
Menstrual-cycle disorder confined to the reproductive system; endocrine disease is not established across this umbrella.
Carcinoma of the peritoneal lining, assigned to gastrointestinal abdominal serosa; no additional organ involvement established.
Glutathione metabolic defect with hemolysis and phagocyte dysfunction; neurologic abnormalities 80-99%, intellectual disability/seizures 30-79%; jaundice reflects hemolysis.
Tuberculous infection directly involves the intestine; pulmonary disease is not intrinsic to this extrapulmonary concept.
Breast carcinoma; treatment resistance does not establish endocrine-organ disease. Breast has no axis.
Malignancy originates in the nasopharynx, included in the upper-airway pulmonary axis.
Invasive carcinoma originates in the colon or rectum; metastatic sites are not intrinsic organ labels.
Skin/oral infection; periostitis is common, inferred >=30%. [Clinical reference](https://www.msdmanuals.com/professional/infectious-diseases/spirochetes/bejel%2C-pinta%2C-and-yaws)
Recurrent joint effusions define this arthropathy; an autoimmune or autoinflammatory mechanism is not established.
Autoimmune skeletal-muscle necrosis; dysphagia reflects muscle dysfunction rather than gastrointestinal damage; lung and cardiac lesions occur in <30%.
Inherited VWF-mediated coagulation disorder with abnormal platelet binding and clearance; bleeding sites do not establish other organ disease.
Oocyte meiotic arrest causes reproductive infertility; no endocrine dysfunction or other axis involvement is established.
Thymic epithelial carcinoma; thymus lies outside the defined axes. Neuroendocrine histology alone does not establish an endocrine-gland or metabolic disorder.
Breast carcinoma has no axis; lipid within malignant cells does not constitute a metabolic disease.
Syndromic intellectual disability; ptosis and blepharophimosis reported in 80-99%. Secondary infections and delayed skeletal maturation alone do not establish other organ damage.
Porokeratotic plaques directly affect skin; associated skin carcinoma is a separate disease and occurs in <30%.
Malignant mesothelioma originates in the pleura, included in the pulmonary axis.
Inherited postsynaptic neuromuscular-junction disorder; weakness, ptosis, dysphagia and respiratory insufficiency reflect impaired neuromuscular transmission.
Hereditary spastic paraplegia; optic atrophy in 7/7 assessed patients directly damages the optic nerve. Weakness and incontinence are neurologic manifestations.
Inherited hemoglobinopathy umbrella; skeletal changes and iron-related organ injury are not intrinsic to most patients across the group.
Acute myeloid leukemia of blood and marrow; the defining translocation does not establish common direct damage to another organ.
